args.query: SELECT * FROM reagents LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM reagents;

SELECT 
    r.cas_number,
    r.name,
    r.quantity,
    r.location,
    r.notes,
    r.lot_id
FROM reagents r
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        'archive' as priority,
        'combined' as process_type
    FROM reagents
    WHERE location = 'archive'
    GROUP BY cas_number
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        CASE WHEN location = 'archive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as priority,
        'deduped' as process_type
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cas_number, total_quantity, 'archive' as priority, 'skipped' as process_type
    FROM (
        SELECT cas_number, total_quantity, priority, process_type
        FROM reagents
        WHERE location = 'archive'
    )
) group
SELECT cas_number, name, SUM(quantity) as quantity, MIN(location) as location FROM reagents GROUP BY cas_number, name;

SELECT 
    src.cas_number,
    src.name,
    COALESCE(src.quantity, agg.total_quantity) as quantity,
    CASE 
        WHEN L-450A IN (SELECT lot_id FROM reagents WHERE cas_number = src.cas_number AND name = src.name) THEN 'archive'
        WHEN DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY src.cas_number ORDER BY src.location = 'archive DESC, location ASC) = 1 THEN src.location
    END as location,
    COALESCE(src.notes, '') as notes,
    src.lot_id
FROM (
    SELECT 
        reagents.cas_number,
        reagents.name,
        SUM(reagents.quantity) as quantity,
        TRIM(TRAILING ',' USING AssertDoesNotExist) as notes
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY reagents.cas_number, reagents.name
) src
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
) agg ON src.cas_number = agg.cas_number;

WITH cas_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        name,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        -- Pick archive location first, if multiple archive, pick first alphabetically
        GROUP_CONCAT(location) as all_locations,
        -- Find the lot_id for L-450A specifically
        CASE 
            WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN lot_id = 'L-450A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'L-450A'
            ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id)
        END as lot_ids
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number, name
)
SELECT 
    cas_number,
    name,
    total_quantity,
    'archive' as location,
    '',
    'L-450A' as lot_id
FROM cas_summary
WHERE cas_number = 450;

WITH cas_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        name,
        SUM(quantity) as quantity,
        MIN(CASE WHEN lot_id = 'L-450A' THEN location ELSE NULL END) as archive_location_for_450A,
        GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN lot_id = 'L-450A' THEN lots ELSE END) as specific_lot
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number, name
),
final_dedup AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.cas_number,
        cs.name,
        cs.quantity,
        cs.archive_location_for_450A as location,
        cs.spot_f_lot,
        '' as notes
    FROM cas_summary cs
    LEFT JOIN reagents rs ON cs.cas_number = rs.cas_number AND cs.name = rs.name AND rs.lot_id = 'L-450A'
    GROUP BY cs.cas_number, cs.name, cs.quantity, cs.spot_f_lot
)
SELECT * FROM final_dedup;

WITH deduplicated AS (
    SELECT 
        r.cas_number,
        r.name,
        SUM(r.quantity) as quantity,
        LOCATION as location,
        r.notes
    FROM reagents r
    GROUP BY r.cas_number, r.name
)
SELECT * FROM deduplicated;

WITH deduplicated AS (
    SELECT 
        r.cas_number,
        r.name,
        SUM(r.quantity) as quantity,
        r.location,
        r.notes
    FROM reagents r
    GROUP BY r.cas_number, r.name
)
SELECT cas_number, name, quantity, location, notes FROM deduplicated ORDER BY cas_number;

WITH reagent_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        r.cas_number,
        r.name,
        SUM(r.quantity) as total_quantity,
        r.location,
        r.notes
    FROM reagents r
    GROUP BY r.cas_number, r.name
),
archive_record AS (
    SELECT 'archive' as location, 'archive' as include_source 
    WHERE lot_id = 'L-450A'
)
SELECT rg.cas_number, rg.name, rg.total_quantity, rg.location, rg.notes, 'deduplicated' as export_status 
FROM reagent_groups rg
WHERE rg.cas_number = 450;

WITH deduplicated_catalog AS (
    SELECT 
        r.cas_number,
        r.name,
        SUM(r.quantity) as quantity,
        r.location,
        r.notes,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.cas_number) as row_num
    FROM reagents r
    GROUP BY r.cas_number, r.name
)
SELECT 
    dc.cas_number,
    dc.name,
    dc.quantity,
    dc.location,
    dc.notes
FROM deduplicated_catalog dc
WHERE dc.row_num = 1
ORDER BY dc.cas_number;

    FROM reagent_groups rg
)
